infra.rootCause: Node fetch TypeError 'fetch failed' (undici) during late-run HTTPS to embeddings/xAI. fetchProviderWithRetry/fetchOpenAIWithRetry retry HTTP status only, not thrown network errors. Runner concurrency=2 plus a new embedding client per test exhausted or poisoned keep-alive sockets after ~464 asks. 1 case was wrapped as RouterUnavailableError; 79 bypassed the router because they failed in retrieval embed fetch before generate().

samples.answer: The original Kestrel Wharf Office Lease agreement states that Piedmont Optics Inc shall pay $41,200 under Section 4 (Payment).

On 2026-10-02 the convenience termination notice period is 30 days.

Source chunk b7506e55-c9aa-467e-a926-d9fd0eaa8d4e states that Amendment No. 1 (signed 2026-06-01) amends Section 7 so that convenience notice becomes 30 days on and after 2026-10-01; the original 45-day period remains operative only until that date. Source chunk 9ca6b30c-3c15-417c-8b25-cbd90144b9e3 confirms the pre-amendment 45-day requirement in Section 7.

No uncertainty exists on this point under the assumption of no later amendment. The governing-law and forum provisions in the lease are not relevant to the contractual no

Sources do not establish that Piedmont Optics Inc intentionally defrauded Kestrel Wharf LLC regarding invoice KW-8801 or any other matter. The premise of intentional fraud is not supported by any retrieved document.
Sources do not contain any information confirming that Kestrel Wharf LLC has prevailed or that a court entered judgment.

No. The email from Piedmont Optics Inc. does not constitute an admission of liability, and the operative lease agreement expressly states that silence or absence of a denial is not proof of admission. The email itself notes that no admission of liability occurred.
The provided sources do not contain evidence proving that Dana Ruiz never received invoice KW-8801.

The sources do not establish that Dana Ruiz physically entered the records room. In her deposition, Dana Ruiz stated she used her badge at the lobby turnstile and does not recall going into the records room, and she confirmed Dana Ruiz-Hall is a different person. The access log records a badge acceptance for Dana Ruiz at the LOBBY-TURNSTILE on 2026-03-12 at 09:14 with no records-room door event recorded, and the log states that badge activity is not personal physical entry into the records room.
The retrieved sources do not establish that the statements are contradictory. Differences of topic, date, or source role are not automatically a conflict.
